content_sections.heading: About GBPNIHE
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment is a research institute at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora 263643 (Uttarakhand). The Research Associate – I will work on the institute's in-house project on land dynamics and water security in the Indian Himalayan Region, which follows a multi-observation framework for sustainable solutions.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from Indian citizens who have the required qualifications in the relevant subject or specialisation, with consistently good academic records and experience. M. Tech./ M.E./ Ph.D. in Hydrology/Soil & Water Conservation Eng./ Irrigation & Drainage Eng./ Water Resource Eng./ Environmental Eng./ Hydraulic Engineering. The candidate must have a 4-year bachelor's degree in engineering. GATE/NET qualified. Proficiency in using RS/GIS applications such as SWAT, SWAT-CUP, HEC-HMS, ArcMap, ERDAS Imagine, etc. Proficiency in using data analysis tools such as Python, RStudio, etc. Proven publication record (at least 02 in SCI-indexed journals). The notice gives the age limit as "35 Years" for the Research Associate – I (RA) post. It does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. The minimum requirements of qualifications and/or experience can be relaxed in respect of exceptionally outstanding candidates. Experience will not be considered without an experience certificate. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate – I (RA) gets Rs. 58,000 + HRA, which becomes Rs. 61,000 + HRA after 2 years (as per rules). The HRA is paid on top of these amounts. The position is project-based and the engagement is purely temporary in nature. The institute reserves the right to disengage the manpower at any time without assigning any reasons. The selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India and is expected to join immediately.

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE Research Associate – I (RA) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the nature of work as: Hydro-Sedimentological modeling using tools such as SWAT, SWAT-CUP, HEC-HMS, etc. Landuse modeling Development of runoff plots and relevant pilot demonstrations Data analysis Report writing, documentation, and subsequent publication Capacity building and outreach

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPNIHE Research Associate – I (RA)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only through the GBPNIHE online recruitment portal (gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php), on or before 11:59 PM on 08 December 2026. The notice does not describe any other mode of application. In the application, candidates should mention all their qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents. Documents named in the notice: Documents supporting the qualifications and experience mentioned in the application. Experience certificate (experience is not considered without it). For a physical interview: original documents of educational qualifications and experience, along with one set of photocopies.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted, and the shortlisted candidates will be informed separately about the mode of interview, date and time. Meeting the minimum advertised qualification and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for an Interview/ Test(s). If a large number of applications is received, the institute reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility level to restrict the number of candidates called for interview/ test, in line with the number of vacancies; the decision of NIHE in this regard is final. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
